label: RGA, en moto et en bivouac. 1800 kilomètres à traver les Alpes.

segments.text: Hello to all. In this video presentation I ride in the French Alps to discover wonderful and winding roads.
I ride up passes, discover beautiful landscapes, ride through regional nature parks.
I bivouac with my tent, I sleep in the nature or in camping and I ride for hours.
I love riding motorbikes, enjoy watching these beautiful images
